numeric_protocol.name: m3_survivor_increment_v1
numeric_protocol.validation: previous calendar year; expanding training ends before validation; purge final two exchange dates from train and validation
numeric_protocol.label: Ref($close,-2)/Ref($close,-1)-1
numeric_protocol.label_normalization: within-day rank on the identical matched universe, (rank_pct-0.5)*3.46; raw return used for evaluation
numeric_protocol.feature_processing: exact 158 raw Qlib expressions; infinities become missing; LightGBM native missing handling; no whole-history fitted preprocessing
numeric_protocol.universe: historical nonfinancial CSI300 with known industry and all surviving neutralized candidates available; cached raw Alpha158 is not restricted by failed BP/CASHFLOW availability

candidate_definitions.name: PAPER101_ALPHA034
candidate_definitions.hypothesis: The fixed Alpha34 composite ranks recent price declines and lower two-day volatility relative to five-day volatility positively.
candidate_definitions.economic_rationale: Researcher interpretation of the formula: combine short reversal with volatility contraction. This interpretation is not a mechanism established by the paper, and may contain only existing Alpha158 information.
candidate_definitions.source_locator: Appendix A, Alpha#34, PDF page 10; operator definitions at end of Appendix A

input_fields.close: Canonical adjusted BaoStock close, observable after close t
input_fields.returns: Canonical adjusted close divided by previous trading-day close minus one; observable after close t

operator_semantics.Delta: Current panel minus the panel one trading day earlier
operator_semantics.Rank: Cross-sectional percentile rank among historical index members; pandas average tie handling
operator_semantics.Std: Trailing full-window sample standard deviation with ddof=1; two and five trading days
operator_semantics.arithmetic: Elementwise subtraction, division and addition; nonfinite final output stays missing

candidate_definitions.direction_evidence: Preserve the published Alpha#34 expression as a positive score; no sign selected from local performance.
deviations: CSI300 historical membership and canonical adjusted prices replace proprietary source data and universe.
Next-day close execution, five-day screening labels and industry/size neutralization follow the fixed local protocol.
Paper does not fully specify standard-deviation ddof or tie rules; local sample ddof=1 and percentile average ranks are explicit reconstruction choices.
The paper's return results are not reproduced; this is one formula transfer on already-observed research history.

numeric_protocol.blend_rule: cross-sectional percentile ranks of base prediction and candidate on the same rows; fixed weights; no selection by blend results
numeric_protocol.selection: No automatic winner selection or protected admission
numeric_protocol.research_status: 2015-2020 burned historical diagnostics, not fresh OOS; engineering completion does not imply independent alpha
numeric_protocol.budget: at most 3 survivors, 24 fits, 7 matched portfolios; no LLM or parameter search

adapter_protocol.scope: Survivors only; BASE and each individual ADD on identical common rows. No combined variants, no tuning. M0 numerical parameters and M2 rolling gate retained.
adapter_protocol.universe: historical nonfinancial CSI300 with known industry and all surviving neutralized candidates available; cached raw Alpha158 is not restricted by failed BP/CASHFLOW availability
adapter_protocol.diagnostics: fixed 75/25 BASE/candidate rank blend; dropping the only added candidate is the identical BASE comparison
adapter_protocol.budget: at most 3 survivors, 24 fits, 7 matched portfolios; no LLM or parameter search
